description: Update an existing email template: change the name, MJML/HTML content, or tags. Call nevent_get_template first to inspect the current version before modifying. At least one of name, content, or tags must be provided. Note: updating a template does NOT retroactively change campaigns already sent with it.

format.description: New template format: "html" or "mjml". Omit to leave unchanged.

html_body.description: New raw HTML content for the template. Omit to leave unchanged.

mjml_body.description: New MJML source code for the template. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: New human-readable name for the template. Omit to leave unchanged.

tags.description: Replacement list of tags. The full tag list is replaced when provided. Omit to leave existing tags unchanged.

template_id.description: Identifier of the template to update. Use nevent_list_templates to get valid template IDs.

name: nevent_update_template
